name.description: Native document names additionally require non-whitespace, well-formed text of at most 200 UTF-16 code units. This authored limit is independent of JSON Schema code-point length.

source.description: Vertex and edge IDs must be unique; edges reference existing vertices and filledFaces reference existing edges.

anyOf.description: Editable embedded single closed nonzero-fill source; vector guide also nonzero. Stretch admits straight forward-only guides; Scatter preserves source Beziers with bounded arc-length placement. 4096 input edges/vertices and stamps, 100000 output commands. No holes or multicolor sources.

repeat.description: Null removes this optional property. Non-destructive total count including source; translation and pivot in parent coordinates, rotation in radians, positive per-step scales. Bounded derived scene: 16384 nodes / 16 MiB.
